resources.string: "Hey Arthur! Jarvis is online and ready to roll. Ask me anything or tap the reactor to start talking!"
"Enables Jarvis to run in the background, detect wake-word commands like Jarvis, and interact with system settings (Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, and Volume) after a one-time user permission grant."
Authorizes Jarvis as Device Administrator to automate hardware controls (Bluetooth, Do Not Disturb, volume, Wi-Fi) and execute autonomous device security in the background.
